label: Starter, BEL scaled to the data after Tohoku, trench to −50 in year 1, UNR positions (exploratory MCMC)
description: starter_jt10_notofree_rev_unr with the BEL prior scaled to the data in every window from March 2011 to 2023 (sigma = half the window's 95th-percentile velocity signal: 2422 mm/yr in the first week, 221 in mid-2011, 25 in 2022; 5 mm/yr before) and Japan Trench coupling down to -50 in the first year after Tohoku. It fits the inland postseismic motion, but the BEL slips fastest beneath the forearc and the trench afterslip is several times smaller than in the other experiments: new Noto mesh, 30 km BEL, UNR IGS20 positions, same 596 GEONET sites and windows
attribution: GNSS: GEONET daily positions, Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI).
Coastline: Global Map Japan, Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (地球地図日本・国土地理院).
Earthquakes: Global CMT catalog (Dziewonski et al., 1981; Ekström et al., 2012).
